transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Honestly, I'm only here because everyone keeps saying I'm way too thin and sick. My family and coworkers are making a huge deal out of it, but I don't really see what the big deal is about my weight right now.

Have you been having episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time and feel out of control while eating? If so, do you then make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise a lot to prevent weight gain?

No, I don't have any episodes like that at all, and I've never made myself throw up or used laxatives. It's actually the exact opposite—I strictly limit what I eat to just coffee, a banana, or some soup because I'm terrified of feeling heavy or bloated.
Even though other people say you’re too thin, do you still feel overweight or strongly fear gaining weight? Do you find yourself checking your body a lot or feeling that certain parts are too fat?

I absolutely dread the thought of gaining weight, and even thinking about eating pizza or dessert makes me panic that I'll become the sloppy, out-of-shape guy my ex used to criticize. But I don't see myself as dangerously thin at all; I just think I look lean and fit, and everyone else is really overreacting.

Have you had any physical effects from the weight loss, like dizziness, fainting, feeling unusually cold, weakness, or your doctor telling you your heart rate is very low? Also, what is your current height and weight?

I have been feeling pretty weak and lightheaded at work lately, and I actually had a near-fainting episode during a shift that sent me to urgent care. I don't know my exact height and weight off the top of my head, but my clothes are definitely hanging off me and I've had to punch new holes in my belt.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient demonstrates restrictive eating leading to significantly low body weight, intense fear of gaining weight, and persistent lack of recognition of the seriousness of low weight. He denies binge-eating and purging behaviors, supporting anorexia nervosa, restricting type under ICD-10 F50.0.
